# Determine if the distribution is normal based on p-value

# Determine if skewness and kurtosis are heavy

kurtosis_heavy = "heavy" if abs(kurtosis_value) > 0.5 else "not heavy"

from scipy import stats

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('cost_data_with_errors.csv')

# Filter the data for the years 2000 to 2010
data = data[data['dates_active'].str.contains(r'\b200\d\b')]

# Extract the year from the dates_active column
data['year'] = data['dates_active'].str.extract(r'(\d{4})')

# Calculate the average damage for each year
average_damage = data.groupby('year')['damage_USD'].mean().round(2)

# Perform ANOVA test
anova_result = stats.f_oneway(*[data[data['year'] == year]['damage_USD'] for year in average_damage.index])

# Extract p-value
p_value = anova_result.pvalue.round(4)

# Determine if there are significant differences
difference_type = "significant" if p_value < 0.05 else "none"

# Print the results
print(f"@average_damage[{', '.join(average_damage.astype(str))}]")
print(f"@p_value[{p_value}]")
print(f"@difference_type[{difference_type}]")
